ITEM 1 | Two rectangular slices with golden-brown, slightly blistered crust edges, topped with red tomato sauce and melted white cheese with some browning; the left slice is about 10 cm long by 7 cm wide and the right slice about 9 cm by 7 cm, each roughly 1.5 cm thick at the crust, sitting side by side on the upper-left area of a large white square plate covering roughly 15% of its surface | 230

ITEM 2 | Red tomato sauce visible as a glossy, slightly spread layer between the cheese and crust on both slices, moist with a light sheen, covering about 40% of the slice tops | 25

ITEM 3 | Melted white cheese with pale yellow-white color, stringy and partly browned spots, lying in irregular clumps over the sauce on both slices, soft and moist, covering about 40% of the slice tops | 30
